subject: Tarmac delay contingency & hotel overflow coordination
messages:
From: Molly Reed <molly@venueco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 14:06:00 -0400
Subject: Potential tarmac delays — can we confirm contingency plan?

Hi Sean,

Quick heads-up from the venue side: the airline ops team flagged that thereʼs an increased chance of tarmac delays for arrivals on Tue/Wed next week due to airspace congestion. That may push some of your crewʼs check-ins into late-night windows.

We wanted to make sure Redwood has an overflow/hoteling contingency (block rooms, late check-in instructions, shuttle windows) and a plan for last-minute swap/standby staff in case flights are delayed beyond reasonable handover times. I attached the current itinerary for reference.

Questions for you:
- Do you want VenueCo to block a small overflow room block now (we can hold till Tuesday noon)?
- Any preferred hotels we should prioritize (we have Hyatt and Comfort Inn options close to the venue)?
- Who should we share shuttle/luggage instructions with on arrival?

If you want, I can hold rooms for 48 hours while you confirm.

Thanks,
Molly Reed
Logistics Manager — VenueCo Events
attachments: itinerary_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Molly Reed <molly@venueco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Atlas Travel <ops@atlastravel.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Potential tarmac delays — can we confirm contingency plan?

Molly —

Appreciate the heads up. Please go ahead and provision a small overflow block at the Hyatt (preferenced) and hold until Tue noon as you suggested. Weʼll confirm final numbers by Monday EOD.

Internal note (ccʼd):
- Marissa: lead on hotel block and final rooming. Confirm how many floaters we should budget for (Iʼm thinking 3 floaters for Tue arrivals).
- Marcus: coordinate shuttle windows and budget impact (need quick estimate for any late-night pick-up fees).
- Lauren: ops on-site point — I want you to draft the arrival handover playbook (handoff times, badge pickup, late check-ins).

Atlas Travel — can you hold the current PNRs and prepare two alt-routing options for flights into BOS and PVD (in case redispatch is needed)? Put provisional flags for airline credit submissions if flights are rebooked.

Budget: we can approve up to $2.5k for overnight contingencies if we need overflow rooms + shuttle; call out if we exceed.

Thanks — Iʼll follow up with a short internal action list.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Action: tarmac delays — assign floaters & hotel overflow (internal)

Team — putting the action items in one place. This is internal only for now; Molly from VenueCo is holding overflow rooms at Hyatt until Tue noon. Please treat as high priority.

Action list (owner / ETA):
- Marissa: Block 6 overflow rooms at Hyatt (3 for floaters + 3 buffer). Send rooming spreadsheet by Mon 10:00 AM. Save one suite for any exec late arrival. (ETA: Mon 10:00)
- Marcus: Confirm shuttle window rates (standard vs late-night), estimate incremental cost. Also confirm whether we can arrange a single coach vs multiple smaller vans depending on pax. (ETA: Mon 3:00 PM)
- Lauren: Draft 1-page arrival handover (badge pickup location, contact numbers, late check-in flow, who to call for temporary badge). Include a one-paragraph note to share with the crew. (ETA: Mon 12:00 PM)
- Sean: I will approve the overflow spend up to $2.5k; if it looks like >$2.5k, Marissa flag early and loop Finance.

Notes: keep all vendor communication threaded and copy me. If flights actually go into tarmac delay >2 hours, weʼll escalate to the on-call lead (I will send the escalation chain in a follow-up).

Cheers,
—Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Travel <ops@atlastravel.com>, Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@tempsolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:47:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Action: tarmac delays — assign floaters & hotel overflow (internal)

All — quick update on confirmations:

Hotel
- Hyatt downtown has agreed to hold 6 rooms until Tue noon. They quoted a one-night/nightly guarantee and a late check-in fee for arrivals after 11:30 PM. I attached the rooming template.
- Comfort Inn is available if we need cheaper overflow but lower distance to venue will add shuttle cost.

Shuttle
- Atlas Travel provided rates: $220 per van (up to 12 pax) after 10:00 PM; $150 standard daytime. If we need two vans overnight, incremental cost ≈ $440 plus tip.

Flights
- Atlas attached two alternate routings and has placed provisional flags for credit submissions; they will wait for our go/no-go.

Budget ask
- Estimated worst-case incremental cost: rooms ($1,200) + shuttle ($440) + incidentals ($200) = $1,840. Below the $2.5k threshold. Please confirm and I will finalize the Hyatt block and send rooming link to the crew.

Attachments: hotel_rooming_overflow.xlsx, flight_alt_options.pdf

Marissa Cole
Event Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: hotel_rooming_overflow.xlsx (xlsx), flight_alt_options.pdf (pdf)
From: Molly Reed <molly@venueco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Atlas Travel <ops@atlastravel.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 17:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tarmac delay contingency & hotel overflow coordination

Sean / team —

All set on our side. Hyatt has held 6 rooms (as requested) and weʼve shared late-checkin instructions with their front desk. Iʼve posted the invoice link below — Hyatt will bill VenueCo and we will forward the itemized invoice to you.

Invoice: https://invoices.venueco.com/invoice/INV-7723
Shared Drive (ops folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bz_field_event_aug-ops

Atlas Travel confirms provisional flags for airline credits have been submitted; they will notify you directly if they require passenger consent or more PNR details.

If anything changes on the flight side, text Lauren (cell in the arrival handover doc) for an immediate swap.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Molly Reed
Logistics Manager — VenueCo Events
